how.safariWidthRule: Safari width (getBoundingClientRect) == CTLine width after replacing the advance of every space glyph with the font's nominal space advance (the width of a CTLine of " " alone): kerning stored on a space glyph (pair space+next) is dropped, kerning on the glyph before a space is kept. For the system font, New York, SF Mono, Courier and Helvetica-Bold this changes nothing on these strings; for Times New Roman and Helvetica regular it does ("safariWidth" below).
